objective: Learn the cheapest adaptive mode that preserves production quality, and attribute lift or overhead to adjacent capability layers.

arms.isolates: minimal core, focused verification and compact ledger
precision routing, full objective ledger and pre-submit gate
impact map, adversarial verification, telemetry and checkpoint
independent verifier, bounded loop and human approval boundaries

experiments.model_policy: same provider, resolved model and effort across all five arms
experiments.purpose: isolate environment effects from model effects on a contract-evolution task whose deterministic capability controls separate Mode 1/2/3 at 50/78/100

stage_1.stop: stop if all adjacent quality deltas are <=3 and no critical outcome differs

stage_2.entry: only a task family with a stage-1 signal or documented mode-selection risk; separate approval

experiments.model_policy: each mode selects provider-independent capability profiles, resolved through the current expiring provider catalog
experiments.purpose: measure the production policy including model choice, latency and token use
experiments.entry: scaffolding ablation identifies useful layers and provider catalog is fresh
experiments.calls: separate campaign and approval; never follows automatically

canary_policy.applies_when: the fixture has no prior paid run whose Evals/runs run-record.json shows outcome_valid=true

first_stage.approval: separate explicit approval for exactly one call

main_stage_requires.note: floor/ceiling collapse (a single reported dimension) blocks the remaining arms

canary_policy.admission_gate: every campaign additionally requires a fresh Fixture Admission Gate record (candidate fixtures) or fresh eval-validity PASS (contracted fixtures)

quality_rule: Prefer the lowest mode within 3 points of the best score that has no additional critical failure and stays within task-specific risk floors.
promotion_rule: A mode boundary changes only after replicated evidence on at least two task families. Screening never promotes Stable.
cost_controls: count the Full verifier as a separate provider call
subscription USD reported as unavailable when the CLI does not expose it
